runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game avs_170h --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/stern/avs-switch-test-loki-control.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. A control for reading the S.A.M. switch test; Pirates of the Caribbean cites it, and its own definition does not.

named_action_observations.label: public 47 (Left Orbit, an ordinary switch) held at 1 for 3 s: the ROM prints LEFT ORBIT, then NONE after the release
Loki opto 49 set to 1: the ROM prints NONE and drops 49 from the grid, so it reads public 1 as inactive
Loki opto 49 set to 0: the ROM prints LOKI LOCK 1 (BOT) and marks 49 in the grid, so it reads public 0 as active
Loki opto 49 set to 1 again: the ROM prints NONE and drops 49 from the grid, so it reads public 1 as inactive
Loki opto 49 set to 0 again: the ROM prints LOKI LOCK 1 (BOT) and marks 49 in the grid, so it reads public 0 as active

raw_runs.name: avs-170h-switch-test-loki-control
raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, and the ROM came up in attract mode with no factory-reset message to dismiss, so the scenario's only service input before the switch test is Back followed by five Select presses

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted key pulses; every retained DMD frame was visually checked, and each diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is that reading of its pixel SHA-256. Exact external directory manifest avs_170h/manifest.json SHA-256 018923f254dae5bff0e8259b73f1cdb25725dc2f1ca72cfe3f521b5b657ffd04 (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py); it lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
